explanation: The loving title Jesus gives to God to show the close, personal relationship between him and people as his children.
A conversation with God in which one expresses gratitude, needs, or requests for help and guidance.
God's presence in believers' lives that provides wisdom, strength, and the ability to live according to God's will.
The close relationship Jesus describes between a friend and his host to illustrate that God hears the requests of his children.
A concept referring to something given or granted by God to those who pray, based on his generosity rather than merit.
Description of what is wicked or harmful in the world, standing in contrast to God's good gift of the Holy Spirit.
